run_mcts_search: run MCTS search on a MiniWob task using policy and critic server stubs to collect episodes
create_episode_from_nodes: create an Episode protobuf from MCTS step nodes containing screenshots, actions, and reward
build_mcts_config: build an MctsConfig with exploration scalar, beam limit, rollout depth, iterations, and rollout weight
search_run_mcts: search and run MCTS on a SearchContext with env, policy, critic, and task configuration
collect_episodes_tfrecord: collect MCTS episodes and write them as serialized Episode protos to a TFRecord file
